title: Frontend Unit Test Module Compiler
description: Compiles frontend unit/integration test suites using Testing Library. Enforces user-centric queries, no real network calls, no shared mutable state, and no weak assertions.

error_codes.UT002: Test uses implementation-detail queries (getByTestId/className) instead of getByRole/getByLabelText
error_codes.UT003: Real network call in unit test — use MSW or vi.mock
error_codes.UT004: Shared mutable state between tests — each test must be isolated
error_codes.UT005: Weak assertion: toBeTruthy/toBeFalsy/toBeDefined without value check
